v-charcuterie-raillard.name: Charcuterie Raillard
v-charcuterie-raillard.verdict: Eddy Raillard's charcuterie on rue Monge: the jambon persillé the critic Gilles Pudlowski called a model of the genre, with gougères and pâté en croûte, sold by the slice to eat standing up.
v-charcuterie-raillard.signature: A thick slice of jambon persillé, with bread and a cornichon.
v-charcuterie-raillard._source: old producer, street-food and eat cards
